media.title: Mutiny on the Bounty (1935) — film poster
media.description: Promotional poster for Mutiny on the Bounty (1935), a Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film represented in the Kaper database as Work W-F034 / Film F034. The image is sourced from Wikimedia Commons and has been treated as public domain in the United States under the pre-1978 no-notice rationale recorded there.
media.altText: Promotional poster for the MGM film Mutiny on the Bounty (1935).
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons marks this poster as public domain in the United States because it was published in the United States between 1930 and 1977 without a copyright notice; the file summary notes no copyright markings, Made in USA, poster version D and Tooker Litho Co. marks. Commons notes that copyright may still subsist in some non-US jurisdictions.
media.publicCaption: Poster for Mutiny on the Bounty (MGM, 1935).
media.publicImageText: The image shows a film poster for Mutiny on the Bounty, with MGM branding and principal cast billing.
